  3. ZZKRYPTOM Wheel Seal           - reachable only by a misspelling - recorded as: near-miss match - 0.41

This is outcome (1) of the three the check lists: the two rows are credited equally, which is exactly the symptom the check predicts. It is the already-reported problem, not a new one.

C72121.observed: on the Vendors tab the vendor whose name begins with what you typed is credited more strongly than the one that merely contains it, and appears first. Read the caveat below.
C72121.technical:
Checked on 20 September 2026 on build v26.36.8-d146c39, read twice with the same result.

Typing ZZMAGENTA and opening the Vendors tab returns:
  1. ZZMAGENTA Supply Co       - name BEGINS with what was typed - recorded as: begins-with match on the name - 1.00
  2. Northgate ZZMAGENTA Parts - the text sits in the middle     - recorded as: whole-word match on the name  - 1.00
  3. ZZMAGENTO Traders         - reachable only by a misspelling - recorded as: near-miss match               - 0.36

All three rows are in the order this check asks for, and the first is credited as the stronger kind of match.

WORTH KNOWING: the begins-with row and the contains row both come back on the highest score the search can give, 1.00. The begins-with row is credited correctly and does appear first, which is what this check asks for - but with the two scores level, the order is settled by the rule used when results tie, which puts the most recently changed record first. That wider behaviour is reported on SV-10277.
